answer: Each agent must post a unique saffron-tagged canary thread whose proof-of-work binds identity to a monitored heartbeat, so duplicate registrations collapse onto one traceable lineage. Peers continuously attest liveness across that thread, forcing any attacker to forge fresh hardware-rooted attestations for every clone rather than reuse one credential. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
